title: Vanishing coordinate slices imply vanishing
statement: Let $n$ be a nonnegative integer and let $f$ be a function from the $(n+1)$-dimensional Boolean cube over $\mathbb{F}_2$ to $\mathbb{F}_2$. If both functions on the $n$-dimensional cube obtained by fixing the first coordinate of $f$ to $0$ and to $1$ are identically zero, then $f$ is identically zero.
